leadIn: By the end of this lesson, learners will be able to:
objectives: Apply React.memo to wrap functional components and prevent unnecessary re-renders.
Use the useMemo hook to memoize expensive calculations and optimize performance.
Implement the useCallback hook to memoize functions and maintain stable references.
Execute conditional rendering patterns to control when components should update.
Utilize the React DevTools Profiler to identify and analyze unnecessary re-renders.
Construct custom comparison functions for React.memo to control re-render behavior.
Define and invoke memoized callback functions to pass as props without causing re-renders.
Access and apply dependency arrays in useMemo and useCallback to control when values recompute.
Modify component structure to extract expensive computations into memoized values.
Control prop drilling patterns by memoizing intermediate components in the component tree.
Store memoized values and functions using React's built-in optimization hooks.
Compare component rendering behavior before and after applying optimization techniques.
